## {{wumi}} Frequently asked questions
The answers to the questions we get the most. **Click a topic**: the answer opens just for you.
-# Didn't find your answer? **Open a ticket**, the team replies quickly. 🇫🇷 La FAQ en français est juste en dessous.

## 🚀 Getting started
**1.** Add Wumi with the **Add Wumi** button in the information channel or at **wumi.fr**.
**2.** Type `/setup` in your server: Wumi walks you through the essentials (language, logs, welcome, levels, moderation) in a few clicks.
**3.** Fine-tune everything later with `/config`, or from the **dashboard** at **dash.wumi.fr** (log in with Discord).

-# Lost? `/help` lists every command, by category.

## 🛠️ Wumi isn't working
**Start with `/diagnostic`.** Wumi checks its own permissions, roles and settings and tells you exactly what's blocking, in red first.

**Commands don't show up?** Make sure the bot was added with its commands, and that *Server Settings › Integrations › Wumi* doesn't hide them in that channel. Restarting Discord (Ctrl+R) helps too.

**Wumi doesn't answer at all?** Check the **status page**: if there's an incident, we're on it.

**Still stuck?** Open a ticket with a screenshot and the result of `/diagnostic`.

## 🔒 Permissions & roles
**"Missing permissions" or a role that won't be given?** Discord only lets a bot manage roles **below its own**.
› *Server Settings › Roles* : drag the **Wumi** role **above** the roles it gives (levels, autorole, reaction roles, verification, mute).

Wumi doesn't need *Administrator*. It asks only for what it uses, and `/diagnostic` lists anything missing.

-# Moderation commands also need the right permission on **your** side (ban, kick, manage messages...).

## 🌍 Language
Wumi speaks **English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese (Brazil) and Italian**.

› The **server language** (messages, cards, logs) is set in `/setup` or `/config` › Server.
› **Command names and descriptions** follow each member's own Discord language, automatically.
› Want to read a message in another language? Right-click it › Apps › **Translate**.

## 🛡️ Moderation & automod
› `/automod` : spam, links, invites, caps, mass mentions, **scams** (on by default), and two AI modules: **toxic messages** and **NSFW images**. Turn each on with `/automod module`.
› `/antiraid` and `/antinuke` protect you from mass joins and from a compromised admin.
› `/audit` gives your server a security score out of 100 and fixes the risky bits in one click.
› `/backup` saves your roles and channels, so you can restore them after an accident.

-# The AI runs on Wumi's own server: no message or image is sent anywhere else.

## 🏆 Levels & rank cards
› Members earn XP by chatting and in voice. `/rank` shows their card, `/leaderboard` the top of the server.
› Role rewards and XP bonuses: `/config` › Levels and `/xp`.
› Each member picks a card theme with `/theme`. Premium servers can set their own card background.

**No XP?** There's a short cooldown between two messages that count, and some channels may not count. Bots never earn XP.

## 🔔 YouTube, Twitch, Instagram...
Wumi posts automatically when you go live or publish something.

› `/watch` : add a **YouTube** channel, a **Twitch** streamer, an **Instagram** account, or any **RSS** feed, and pick the channel and the role to ping.
› Up to 10 sources per server, 30 with Premium.

-# A post can take a few minutes to show up: Wumi checks each source regularly, platforms don't warn bots by themselves.

## 🎵 Music
› `/play` a song or a link, `/radio` for live stations, and `/blindtest` to play with friends.
› Join a voice channel first: Wumi follows you.

**No sound?** Check that Wumi can *Connect* and *Speak* in that channel, and that it isn't server-muted.

## 💎 Wumi Premium
**Premium raises limits, it never locks features.** A free server keeps everything it has.

› More announcement sources, giveaways, tickets per member and structure snapshots.
› **Your own bot on your server**: name, avatar, banner and bio with `/premium bot`.
› A custom background for every card with `/premium card-background`.

**Try it free for 7 days**, once per server: `/premium trial`.
-# Like Wumi? A `/vote` on top.gg takes ten seconds and really helps.

## 🔐 Your data & privacy
› `/privacy view` shows what Wumi keeps about you, `/privacy delete` erases it.
› Ordinary messages are read in passing and forgotten immediately. Nothing is sold, nothing is shared.
› The AI (automod, translation) runs on Wumi's own server.

-# Full details in our privacy policy.
